svg.title: Spateo Referee — signal-dependent QC, window handling and binary decisions
svg.desc: Editable vector workflow. Joint review v2. Panels A–F contain current implementation branches; code function names in object descriptions provide traceability. All labels are live Arial text. No raster or embedded HTML.

g.title: title and reading key
g.text: Signal-dependent slice QC • sliding windows • evidence aggregation • auditable keep / exclude
Metric-stress tested; independent biological validation incomplete

g.inkscape:label: A - Input contracts & signal routing
g.text: One biological series at a time; preserve raw coordinates and identities

g.title: a contract
g.text: Record units, selected layer and source hashes

g.title: a geometry
g.desc: _geometry_metrics: n<2 returns NaN geometry and conservative defaults; invalid x/y excluded from geometry

g.title: a semantic 425
g.text: Use obs counts / genes if present

g.inkscape:label: B - Sliding windows & boundaries
g.text: Focal slice is excluded from its own local reference

g.title: b sliding window example
g.desc: _local_expected uses positional slice order, not physical z spacing; focal excluded; no wrap or padding
g.text: Move the focal index i through the ordered series

g.title: b support
g.desc: _score_metrics: support=max(W, max(3, min(9, largest odd <=N))); internal=np.any(two_sided_matrix)
g.text: Score both; take larger metric anomaly. Support width ≥W, usually up to 9.
Keep primary context; score_confidence = 1 if supported on both sides, else 0.72.
Different specimens never share neighbors; missing slice IDs do not imply poor tissue.

g.inkscape:label: C - Metric standardization
g.text: Directional effect size + robust residual; no probability interpretation

g.title: c input
g.text: Observed value v + local expectation e

g.title: c merge
g.desc: _metric_anomaly; invalid observation/reference gives zero anomaly evidence
g.text: A = max(R, Z) × context factor × agreement penalty
Agreement penalty = clip(exp(−left/right disagreement / (2.5 × global scale)), .35, 1)
For counts / genes, retain the larger direct relative-drop score (same context penalty).
Primary and support scores are combined by max; missing evidence is not a normality claim.
Profile / type continuity uses its own divergence mapping before domain aggregation.

g.inkscape:label: D - Four domains → aggregate score
g.text: Signals may contribute to more than one domain; domains are not independent

g.title: d domain Continuity
g.text: Unavailable profile / labels add no evidence

g.title: d available
g.text: Weighted mean renormalizes finite signals; top-two = .65 × strongest + .35 × second

g.title: d endpoint
g.text: If one-sided: S ← .82 × S. Otherwise keep S. Clip final score to [0,1].
Pass S, domain scores, context and protection flag to E.

g.inkscape:label: E - Two-stage filtering
g.text: Only keep / exclude are public; all review routes remain in the audit

g.title: e detector
g.text: With two sides + no protection: exclude if (S≥.64 AND ≥2 strong domains),
OR X≥.78, OR (D≥.82 AND holes≥.55 AND C≥.42).
Else review if S≥.38, any domain≥.45, any severe domain≥.78,
any metric≥.75 or protection; otherwise detector keep.

g.title: e all gates
g.desc: _evaluate_review_tier_row: primary confidence only; all-window support=1.0; upper tier bound applies to primary only
g.text: AND: every required evidence condition passes
Detector review/exclude + two-sided + no protection + confidence≥.90
Every available 3/5/7 window: same guards, domain count / severity,
and selected tier floor (.129 or .540); no window details → fail.
Non-finite score / insufficient evidence → conservative keep + recorded diagnostics.

g.inkscape:label: F - Audit, display & exact ROI
g.text: Display transforms never feed back into QC scores or decisions

g.title: f audit
g.text: Save one audit row per original slice
Raw score, detector call, stage-1 route, stage-2 tier, window checks, failed gates, final_call
Freeze policy + hashes; experimental_policy clears certification. Keep ≠ proven healthy.

g.title: f rigid
g.text: Separate middle-slice reference for each dataset
Translation + rotation; no scale / mirror / deformation

g.title: f fit status
g.desc: slice_preregistration.py: failure / ambiguity warnings propagate along composed chain

g.title: f warn
g.text: Do not turn fit error into QC

g.title: f viewer
g.desc: slice_quality_visualization.py: render_binary_slice_quality_appendix; raw/display toggle; linked 3/5 slice windows
g.text: Current viewer: KDE • capture • components • statistics • binary calls

g.title: f roi
g.desc: slice_quality_detail_roi.js; export-roi: frame_id, source_row, obs_name, full-cache hashes; never use raw axis-aligned bounding box as exact inverse
g.text: ROI: display rectangle → exact selected points → inverse raw polygon

g.title: figure notes
g.text: A → B → C → D → E → F; availability branches in A may operate in parallel.
K=0.129; split=0.540; E=0.700; strongest domain low/high=0.65/0.60. Local references can adapt; these policy values do not.
Named SVG groups contain source-function descriptions. Full metric limits, score mappings and validation scope: companion methods document.
